name: Tolka Sport Runlite
description: A stripped-down running shoe designed for high mileage on a low budget. Single-piece foam midsole, thin knit upper, minimal branding. Nothing fancy, nothing broken. Tier 2 runners who log serious distance trust these because they're predictable.
functionality: Reflective heel strip for low-light visibility. Passive only.
what_it_says: You run because you need to, not because it's a lifestyle. You know what your feet want.
worn_by: people who run before their shift
story_hooks: A courier was wearing these when they disappeared with a package that apparently didn't exist.
Tolka sponsors a free community running club on the Tier 2 greenway. The shoes are the membership fee.
